scope: Exactly the 117 excluded WHOLE constructions in the immutable D10 inventory. Metadata-only; no new source views, feature classes, roles or letter assignments.
method: Exact row IDs, half-open native bboxes, final exclusion text, source adjudication, raw A/B evidence pointers and all local mark locators are preserved.
Mechanical exclusion mechanisms are counted separately from multivalued reported content causes.
The category ID sets are explicit metadata interpretations; generic background/photographic/owner-alternative boilerplate is not evidence of a specific physical impediment.
No described source limitation is upgraded to physically unavailable pixels. The prior views were not reopened by this audit.
The pre-existing WHOLE schema/envelope is not treated as proof of one indivisible symbol or a traced ink contour. Frozen policy conflicts are not physical impossibility proofs.
UNKNOWN semantic roles/letter values do not explain physical exclusion and stay UNKNOWN.

cause_label_definitions.FROZEN_PRIOR_OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT: The frozen baseline reports a pre-existing same-instance/adjacent-row ownership conflict. This is inherited content plus a policy gate, not a new proof that pixels are unavailable.
cause_label_definitions.TARGET_WINDOW_CONTAMINATION: Metadata specifically reports neighboring construction ink, a competing path/body, or a neighboring-row fragment inside/at the target envelope. This does not assign ownership.
cause_label_definitions.DETACHED_MARK_OR_SMALL_ATTACHMENT_OWNERS: A discrete dot, dash, fleck, point or small attachment is specifically reported with unresolved attachment or ownership; substantial neighboring-body fragments are classified separately.
cause_label_definitions.CLOSURE_OPENING_OR_DARK_JUNCTION: A specific closure/opening, small inset, crowded/dark junction or uncertain closure field prevents a complete topology inventory. Generic photographic caveats are not counted.
cause_label_definitions.DIRECTION_OR_FEATURE_COUNT_VOCABULARY: The adjudication identifies conflicting terminal direction, lateral extent, arch/branch vocabulary or feature count. This is not established physical pixel loss.
cause_label_definitions.BACKGROUND_INTERFERENCE_REPORTED: A specific reported background-confounded relation, faint band crossing or ink/background ambiguity affects this construction. The global retained-background boilerplate and mere owner alternatives do not establish this cause.
cause_label_definitions.FINE_ATTACHMENT_OR_TERMINAL_CONTINUITY: A specific fine connection, crossing, terminal or short branch cannot be securely allocated/inventoried in the recorded observations.
cause_label_definitions.TARGET_EXTENT_AT_OR_BEYOND_BASE_WINDOW: Recorded target entry/shoulder lies at or beyond an approximate immutable envelope; same-body extension versus adjacent trace remains unresolved.
